title: East Sabah — Dangerous Grounds: three competing tectonic working models
classification: PUBLIC-SAFE SYNTHESIS; excludes PETRONAS well-level values and internal maps. Hypotheses and falsifiers only.
source_handoff: F13 sovereign handoff east_sabah_dangerous_grounds_models.json 2026-10-08 (rendered on arif-fazil.com/earth lane)
orientation: NW Dangerous Grounds -> SE East Sabah; ridge axis question along PEKAKA-LAYANG2-TEPAT strike line
protocol: GEOX computes and contrasts; ARIF or arifOS adjudicates. Local ceiling QUALIFIED_CANDIDATE.

models.name: ARIF EXTENSION-RIDGE MODEL
models.core: A linked Tepat-Layang-Layang-Pekaka magmatic/extensional axis created a basaltic ridge or segmented spreading-like corridor; later shortening transmitted stress toward Kinabalu and Dangerous Grounds.
supports: Volcanic and volcaniclastic penetrations/interpretations occur along the trend
Deep-seated faults and crustal thinning provide magma conduits
Gravity and magnetic anomalies identify dense and susceptible bodies
registered_tension: DG province is attenuated/rifted CONTINENTAL crust (dgr_clm_1, MED-HIGH) - a continuous oceanic-type ridge conflicts with crust truth
SCS spreading terminated >=16 Ma (sys_clm_4, HIGH) while Kinabalu magmatism is ~7-14 Ma contested (sys_clm_6) - magmatism is demonstrably multi-generation, not one syn-extensional axis
Deep-crust hypothesis H3 volcanic/rifted basement is weakest of four (p50 0.18, CLM-NWS-006) with a near-zero-cost mag/grav kill test

Chronostrat v2 witness record (0-66 Ma) contains NO volcanic body along the trough axis - the 'unrecorded event' remains unrecorded everywhere in the witness set (weak evidence: record is interpretive)

Post-collision trough regime is LOADING_DOMINANT (two-oceanics 4.25x) with gravity-driven toe-thrusting - an ACTIVE extensional ridge during Miocene shortening lacks a kinematic home; A survives mainly as an INHERITED (>=16 Ma) feature, which converges on Model C
fails_if: No along-strike continuity in corrected gravity/magnetics
Intrusions have unrelated ages or geochemistry
Restoration shows no shared extensional kinematics

models.name: UNDERTHRUST + MUD-CANOPY MODEL
models.core: Dangerous Grounds continental crust underthrust NW Sabah; overpressured Setap-equivalent shale, sediment loading and gravity-driven deformation formed minibasins, mud pipes, flows and the North Sabah-Pagasa mud canopy.
evidence_split: Canopy half DOCUMENTED: Morley et al. 2023 Geosphere - ~50 centres, ~1,900 km2 dense canopy; Morley 2024 NSPW mobile shale 8-9 km over ~75,000 km2 (= CLM-NWS-007 p50 0.32)
Underthrust half UNTESTED HYPOTHESIS: sys_clm_3/dgr_clm_2 LOW confidence, pending well-tied dip line across the trough; forbidden for drilling decisions
Subduction polarity and timing UNDER RESOLUTION - HOLD, both recorded, do not average (sys_clm_5)
Geometry admitted (not proven) by the F13-settled two-surface-family rule: pre-LANGGAR lower-plate surfaces dip SE beneath the wedge (sys_clm_8/9)
fails_if: Deep anomalies require a continuous igneous ridge
Observed strain cannot be balanced by underthrust/loading
Mud bodies prove igneous rather than sedimentary origin

models.name: HYBRID INHERITED CORRIDOR MODEL
models.core: An inherited SEGMENTED extensional-magmatic corridor localized volcanism and rifting before and during margin reorganization; later Dangerous Grounds underthrust, flexure, sediment loading and shale mobility overprinted it. The ridge is discontinuous and multi-stage, not one simple spreading center.
models.compatibility: Contradicted by ZERO registered GEOX claims. Inherited rift fabric (dgr_clm_1), forebulge carbonates (dgr_clm_4), loading-dominant collision (two-oceanics), BANGKIT late-Miocene overprint (sys_clm_6), two-surface-family geometry (sys_clm_8/9), chronostrat two-generation magmatic record (DG NP23 volcanics + Kinabalu granite) all compatible.
fails_if: All volcanic bodies postdate deformation and lack structural linkage
No inherited extensional fabric beneath the trough
A single end-member model explains all seismic and potential-field observations

adjudication_2026_10_08.verdict: C preferred working model; A and B live falsifiable alternatives; NONE sealable
adjudication_2026_10_08.adjudicator: FI-008 warga analysis, grounded in registered claims (kernel judge lane BLOCKED: L11 SCT alias defect, 3 attempts, documented kernel-actor-mismatch-falsehold-2026-10-02.md - no machine seal rendered)
adjudication_2026_10_08.contrast_one_liner: A's strong form fails crust truth + timing; A's weak form collapses into C. B is half-documented (canopy) and half-open (underthrust untested, polarity HOLD). C is the only model contradicted by nothing registered.
open_holds: underthrust_continuation_untested (dgr holds; falsifier = well-tied dip line across trough)

discriminating_tests.detail: Band-pass gravity/magnetics + 2.5D/3D forward models along/across the PEKAKA-LAYANG2-TEPAT strike
discriminating_tests.decision: Continuous narrow deep anomaly favors A; discontinuous bodies favor C; no magmatic anomaly favors B
discriminating_tests.cost: NEAR-ZERO (public data reprocessing, ~6 months; already registered as CLM-NWS-006 H3 kill test)

discriminating_tests.detail: Radiometric ages, whole-rock/trace-element, isotopes for volcanic intervals along trend
discriminating_tests.decision: Shared age/geochemical lineage favors A/C; unrelated pulses weaken A
Common extension axis and outward fault polarity favor A/C

discriminating_tests.detail: Wide-angle/refraction (OBS 150 km across Sabah Trough), PSDM velocity, MT/CSEM
discriminating_tests.decision: Mafic ridge needs high Vp/density beneath sediment; mobile shale predicts low velocity in overburden (but shale LVZ contaminates the discriminator - CLM-NWS-007)

discriminating_tests.detail: Reflection terminations, feeder geometry, density, velocity, petrology
discriminating_tests.decision: Mud-canopy pipes/flows must remain distinct from dikes/sills and volcanic edifices

literature: Morley et al. 2023 Geosphere 19(1) 291 - North Sabah-Pagasa mud canopy
